Robin AI is on a mission to revolutionize the legal industry by simplifying contracts and making law accessible to everyone. We utilize cutting-edge machine learning and contract software, enhancing traditional legal services and bringing together experts in engineering, AI, and law. Robin AI has recently raised $26m in Series B funding and has seen an impressive 5x revenue growth in the last 12 months.

We're looking for passionate, resourceful and collaborative people to join Robin. If you're motivated by leveraging technology to make essential business services more accessible, come join us!

I am developing a comprehensive question bank to test individuals on various skills required for different jobs and their respective seniority levels. This project involves utilizing AI to generate job descriptions, skills, and relevant questions per job title and seniority level. I need an experienced professional to help streamline this process, ensure accuracy, and provide sources for all AI-generated questions.

practice OVERVIEW

Radiology Partners, through its owned and affiliated practices, is a leading radiology practice in the U.S., serving hospitals and other healthcare facilities across the nation. As a physician-led and physician-owned practice, we advance our bold mission by innovating across clinical value, technology, service and economics, while elevating the role of radiology and radiologists in healthcare. Radiology is a team sport, and Radiology Partners is building a community of physicians and support teammates who embody our practice values and believe in our bold mission to transform radiology. Our support team is a vital force within the practice, using their gifts and talents to improve the overall healthcare experience. Using a proven healthcare services model, Radiology Partners provides consistent, high-quality care to patients, while delivering enhanced value to the hospitals, clinics, imaging centers and referring physicians we serve.

Position Summary

Radiology Partners is seeking a VP, Imaging AI & Technology sales professional to represent Canopy Partners as a key sales executive, providing market and business intelligence and developing action plans to realize and achieve Canopy's sales objectives. Your performance and contributions will provide the company with a firm foundation for making sound decisions and ensuring overall sustainability.

Position Duties and Responsibilities

• Responsible for selling two (2) Million dollars of RP and Canopy's imaging IT solutions within a defined sales territory. Results will be tracked and measured every quarter

• Meet or exceed the annual revenue and EBITDA growth targets for your position

• Develop and maintain a strong sales pipeline with more than enough opportunities to achieve your sales targets

• Hold pitch meetings which include but are not limited to; Developing pitch presentations, materials, and messaging in collaboration with RP leadership

• Can control a room and pitch face-to-face in meetings, at events, speaking engagements and is also able to pitch digitally

• Provide marketplace feedback to inform business strategy through deep knowledge and understanding of the market, client needs, and industry trends

• Develop relationships with C-Level executives and decision makers (physician leaders, IT staff, RIS/PACS administrators, radiology directors, etc.)

• Develop relationships both on the clinical and operational side of target accounts to properly present and sell meaningful solutions

• Work with internal Canopy departments (Business Development, HR, IT, RCM, PMO) to develop creative ways to position and sell service offerings

• Follow Canopy's defined sales process to develop opportunities, create product proposals, and negotiate final terms and pricing with client decision-makers

• Research the imaging industry and accounts in your territory becoming well-versed in operating models, business challenges, critical metrics, issues, goals, and growth strategies

• In collaboration with your team and VP, create and develop a detailed target account strategy for your region.

• Clearly articulate the RP and Canopy Partners stories and value proposition

• Build, cultivate, and leverage relationships in accounts to increase Canopy's products/services penetration.

• Drive and uncover net new business opportunities within your territory

• Become the Trusted Advisor of your key accounts by providing market insights on industry trends, competitive landscape information, and healthcare legislation information that assists the account in reaching its goals

• Identify a strong funnel of growth potential by analyzing contract status, standardization plan, evaluating current contracts, products, needs, care gaps install base, and construction strategies to leverage into deal strategies

• Coach and lead the rest of our team to meet and manage customer expectations throughout the sales process

• Keep detailed and up-to-date records of your sales activities, accounts, and contacts using SalesForce.com

• Develop action plans to realize and achieve Canopy's vision for market share

• Provide frequent reports and updates on customer activity, competitive analysis, and customer service to Canopy management

• Travel to trade shows and relevant events to promote the Canopy brand, products and services as necessary

• Provide market and business intelligence to Canopy management and staff

• Promote a culture that reflects the organization's values, encourages good performance, and enhances productivity

• Perform other duties as necessary

DESIRED PROFESSIONAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution preferred, plus 5-10 years of sales and marketing experience; preferably in health care ideally in medical imaging/informatics: or an equivalent combination of education and experience

• In-depth knowledge of CRM systems, and Microsoft Office Products (Word, Excel, Access, Outlook, and PowerPoint)

• Excellent written and oral communication skills, interpersonal skills, and organizational skills

• Must be able to unilaterally make strategic decisions, generate innovative ideas and solutions, and multitask due to a wide variety of tasks and constantly changing activities in the area

• Able to read, examine, and interpret information such as reports, charts, and graphs and must be able to present information persuasively and effectively to internal and external stakeholders

• Effectively respond to inquiries from, and work collaboratively with, all functions and levels within the organization
• Able to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions, along with interpreting an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical and diagram form and dealing with several abstract and concrete variables

Radiology Partners is an equal opportunity employer. RP is committed to being an inclusive, safe and welcoming environment where everyone has equal access and equitable resources to reach their full potential. We are united by our Mission to Transform Radiology and in turn have an important impact on the patients we serve and the healthcare system overall. We hold that diversity is a key source of strength from which we will build a practice culture that is inclusive for all. Our goal is to empower and engage the voice of every teammate to promote awareness, compassion and a healthy respect for differences.

The salary range for this position is $160,000.00 - $175,000.00. Final determinations may vary based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, geographic location etc. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Overview

BigBear.ai is seeking a Computer Vision Engineer forefront of bridging the gap between complex data, advanced machine learning models, and tangible computer vision applications. The role encompasses the development and deployment of robust computer vision models and analytics, aiding in building intelligent systems and informing strategic decisions through data-driven insights. You will work closely with a diverse team of engineers and researchers to develop and implement high-performance, scalable, and reliable computer vision systems.

What You Will Do
• Design, develop, and deploy advanced computer vision models, ensuring they are performant and scalable
• Align model development with the practical applications and specific problem domains within the organization
• Enhance existing computer vision algorithms for better accuracy and efficiency
• Explore and implement optimization techniques for model performance improvement in real-world applications
• Conduct exploratory data analysis to discover patterns, anomalies, and insights within the data
• Stay abreast of the latest developments and advancements in computer vision and machine learning
• Collaborate closely with engineers, researchers, and product teams to integrate computer vision capabilities into products and workflows
• Work with product teams to ensure smooth product delivery with high standards, prioritize short-term returns and long-term growth
• Take a creative and strategic approach to solve hard problems. Simplify the complex. Bring in fresh ideas from new places

• Bachelor's Degree and 10 to 12 years of experience; Master's Degree and 8 to 10 years of experience; PhD and 5 to 7 years of experience (in lieu of Bachelor’s degree, 6 additional years of relevant experience)
• Proficient experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, MXNet, or TensorFlow
• Proficient programming skills in Python and C++
• In-depth knowledge of deep learning, covering aspects such as layer architecture, loss functions, optimization techniques, and more
• Hands-on experience in computer vision, image processing, and machine learning, with a demonstrable track record of developing and deploying models into production
• Proven understanding of State-of-the-Art deep learning techniques for computer vision
• Hands-on experience with computer vision libraries such as Scikit-Image, OpenCV, Pillow (PIL Fork), TorchVision, MMCV, Detectron2, and Albumentations
• Knowledge of hardware acceleration libraries like NVIDIA CUDA-X, NVIDIA Performance Primitives, and OpenVINO
• Strong programming and debugging skills
• Problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically and creatively
• Strong communication and presentation skills to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

• Experience with CUDA or other GPU programming languages
• Knowledge of software development best practices, including version control (e.g., Git), unit testing, and continuous integration

Headquartered in Columbia, Maryland, BigBear.ai is a public company traded on the NYSE under the symbol BBAI.
